# jimble

> Java の Web アプリケーションフレームワーク。注釈も DI も使わない。
> A web framework for Java. No annotations, no dependency injection.

## Docs

- [ja](https://jimble.io/ja/llms.txt): 38 pages. Full text: https://jimble.io/ja/llms-full.txt
- [en](https://jimble.io/en/llms.txt): 38 pages. Full text: https://jimble.io/en/llms-full.txt

## Notes

- Every page is also served as Markdown at the same path with a `.md` suffix
  (for example https://jimble.io/ja/routing.md).
- Source: https://github.com/hidemikimura/jimble
